headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the San Diego Padres took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-2, with Walker Buehler earning the win, and the Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners 10-1 behind a strong performance from Miles Mikolas.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Corey Seager, who was placed on the 7-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a concussion. The Los Angeles Angels also placed Grayson Rodriguez on the 15-day injured list due to low back inflammation. The New York Mets have placed Jorge Polanco on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion and Christian Scott on the 15-day injured list with right hip impingement.

The Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, and the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates in 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Walker Buehler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, and 6 H. Rodolfo Durán led the Padres' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Mariners 10-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, winning 10-1 behind a strong performance from Miles Mikolas, who pitched 7.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 8-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Camilo Doval earning the win in relief. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Marlins 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins in a one-sided matchup, securing a 7-0 victory. Impact players for the Phillies included Brandon Marsh, J.T. Realmuto, and Zack Wheeler, who led the team to a decisive win.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Jac Caglianone and Dylan Crews contributing to the winning effort.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to June 12, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
